newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains firm on weather concerns, quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains firm on weather concerns, quiet.

text.p: Soaring LIFFE grain futures on growing weather concerns pushed UK cash grain prices higher, but drove most players out of the market.
"Futures have really taken off but the cash market doesn't want to follow," said one broker.
Brokers said firm overseas markets were also playing their part in the bullish trend.
"Suddenly people have decided to wait and see what Chicago is going to do. But really it's just an excuse. The market has gone too high too fast for most people," said another broker.
Brokers on the fob market reported no business and very few markets.
Delivered trade was slow with no business reported for milling wheat or feed barley.
Feed wheat in East Anglia was fetching 103.50 stg for May and 106 stg for Jul.
